    Path and OD Network

    Source: R/netPath.R
    make_net_path.Rd

    Generates an OD network and a Leg Count data frame(on demand)

    Usage

    make_net_path(x, leg = FALSE, zero = FALSE, carrier = FALSE)

    Arguments

    x

    Data frame

    leg

    Generates Leg Count Data frame, based on Path taken.

    zero

    Displays percentage of 0 usd tickets

    carrier

    Groups data per airline

    For example, all passengers doing the BOS-ATL-LAX path, are summed by Air Carrier.

    Value

    With leg = FALSE, a data frame (data.table) with one row per origin and destination pair: passengers, average fare and its standard deviation, yield, mean number of stops, mean distance, city information, year and quarter (plus the percentage of 0 usd tickets with zero = TRUE). With leg = TRUE, an object of class skynet: a list with netOD, the data frame above, and netLegCount, a data frame (data.table) with the passengers per path taken, its carriers and its number of legs (legCount).

    Examples

    make_net_path(OD_Sample)
